item.title: Correction: our bots cast their card draw in their own upkeep
item.description: Two misplays were costing blue decks games. Fixing them brought blue back toward real results. Red-green still leads Reality Fracture, and Way of the Warlord still looks like a sleeper, but Way of the Mentor doesn't.

item.title: Reality Fracture, drafted 480 times before release
item.description: 60 simulated pods and 60,000 games. Red-green leads, black-green trails, and the Way of the ... cycle splits in two even though bots take every one around pick 10.
